summary: 52-year-old Texas woman was thrown from a commercial raft after it struck a rock on the San Miguel River during a guided trip (2 rafts, 9 passengers, 3 guides); she spent ~10 minutes in 38-degree water, was pulled unconscious and not breathing, and a river guide performed two cycles of CPR and revived her; Norwood ambulance took her to Uncompahgre Medical Center, then a helicopter to Montrose Memorial Hospital; hypothermic with orthopedic trauma, expected to recover
location: San Miguel River (guided trip, Telluride area)
notes: Date from the San Miguel County Sheriff's Office announcement/tweet of June 7, 2016 (Tuesday); KVNF newscast headline; helicopter evac to Montrose Memorial.
